data.narrative:
Realta Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $36M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 11 total peers—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Fuse Energy, Valar Atomics, Oklo, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy, all operating in the same frontier nuclear sector at seed through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using the $36M raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yields $72M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 most directly comparable same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (Valar Atomics at $6.0B Series B, Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M Seed, and Fuse Energy at $200M Series A) produces a median valuation of $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $61M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $440M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation multiples in an early-stage, capital-intensive sector where peer valuations span nearly two orders of magnitude. Key variables affecting placement within this range include progress on engineering milestones, capital efficiency relative to peers, and macroeconomic conditions affecting nuclear investment cycles.
